title: License Clause Matching
description: License Clause Matching is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Matches software use against license clauses automatically. Declared usage is compared clause-by-clause against the license text; mismatches are listed. It takes usage declaration, license and produces match report. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: every clause is checked, none skipped.

fields.mechanism: Declared usage is compared clause-by-clause against the license text; mismatches are listed.
fields.guarantees: every clause is checked, none skipped

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Compliance Scoring
description: Compliance Scoring is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Scores an organization 0–100 on license compliance. Each clause carries a weight; satisfied clauses add their weight to the score. It takes clause matches and produces score. Tunable parameters: 0–100. Guarantee: identical usage always scores identically.

fields.mechanism: Each clause carries a weight; satisfied clauses add their weight to the score.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Automated Verdicts
description: Automated Verdicts is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Issues a verdict — compliant, warning, or violation — with cited reasons. The verdict engine applies the rule set and cites the exact clauses behind the decision. It takes evidence and produces verdict + citations. Tunable parameters: 3 outcomes. Guarantee: verdicts always cite their clauses.

fields.mechanism: The verdict engine applies the rule set and cites the exact clauses behind the decision.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Appeal Workflow
description: Appeal Workflow is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Lets either side appeal a verdict with new evidence. Appeals reopen the case with the new evidence attached; a different rule path reviews it. It takes appeal + evidence and produces second verdict. Tunable parameters: one appeal per case. Guarantee: appeals never reuse the original reviewer path.

fields.mechanism: Appeals reopen the case with the new evidence attached; a different rule path reviews it.
fields.guarantees: appeals never reuse the original reviewer path

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Remediation Plans
description: Remediation Plans is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Generates a step-by-step plan to return to compliance. Each violated clause maps to remediation steps with owners and deadlines. It takes violations and produces plan. Tunable parameters: per clause. Guarantee: plans always include deadlines.

fields.mechanism: Each violated clause maps to remediation steps with owners and deadlines.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-License Conflict
description: Multi-License Conflict is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Detects when two licenses on one project contradict each other. License compatibility is checked pairwise from a compatibility matrix. It takes license set and produces conflict report. Tunable parameters: matrix lookup. Guarantee: conflicts always name both licenses.

fields.mechanism: License compatibility is checked pairwise from a compatibility matrix.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Audit Snapshots
description: Audit Snapshots is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Freezes a point-in-time compliance snapshot for auditors. The snapshot captures usage, licenses, and verdicts with a hash for tamper evidence. It takes system state and produces snapshot. Tunable parameters: SHA-256. Guarantee: snapshots are never editable.

fields.mechanism: The snapshot captures usage, licenses, and verdicts with a hash for tamper evidence.

title: Copyleft Tracing
description: Copyleft Tracing is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Traces copyleft obligations through dependency trees. Dependencies are walked transitively; copyleft licenses flag their obligations upstream. It takes dependency tree and produces obligation list. Tunable parameters: transitive. Guarantee: no transitive dependency is ever skipped.

title: Grace Remediation Window
description: Grace Remediation Window is a governance ability in the Automated License & Compliance Arbitration database. Gives violators a fixed window to fix issues before penalties. A violation starts a 30-day window; fixing within it clears the violation record. It takes violation events and produces windows. Tunable parameters: 30 days. Guarantee: windows never extend.

title: Penalty Calculation

Severity and duration feed a fixed formula; the math is shown with the penalty. It takes violation record and produces penalty. Tunable parameters: published formula. Guarantee: identical violations always cost identically.

Approved combos are stored with their approval date and scope. It takes approvals and produces registry. Tunable parameters: per combo. Guarantee: the registry never approves conflicting combos.

Each dependency update re-runs clause matching; new violations alert immediately. It takes update stream and produces alerts. Tunable parameters: per update. Guarantee: monitoring never sleeps through an update.

Evidence uploads are hash-chained and timestamped on arrival. It takes evidence files and produces vault. Tunable parameters: hash-chained. Guarantee: evidence is never alterable.

title: Settlement Builder

The builder proposes terms from the verdict and remediation plan; both sides edit until agreed. It takes case file and produces draft terms. Tunable parameters: iterative. Guarantee: drafts never bind without both signatures.
